question: What is my purpose?
short_answer: The Quran states the purpose directly. It is to know Allah, to worship Him, and to live in a way that reflects that knowing.

sections.heading: The stated purpose
sections.body: The Quran does not leave purpose unclear. It states it plainly. The purpose is tied to the One who created.

evidence.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَالْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
evidence.translation_en: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
evidence.why_cited: It names the purpose of creation directly.

evidence.arabic: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ
evidence.translation_en: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?
evidence.why_cited: It denies that creation is without purpose.

evidence.arabic: الَّذِي خَلَقَ الْمَوْتَ وَالْحَيَاةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا
evidence.translation_en: It is He who created death and life to test you as to which of you is best in deed.
evidence.why_cited: It places the purpose inside the test of action.

sections.heading: What worship means
sections.body: The Quran describes worship as broader than ritual. It includes gratitude, remembrance, patience, and doing good.

evidence.arabic: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
evidence.translation_en: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
evidence.why_cited: It places remembrance and gratitude together.

evidence.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالْإِحْسَانِ وَإِيتَاءِ ذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ
evidence.translation_en: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives.
evidence.why_cited: It names justice, good conduct, and giving as commands.

evidence.arabic: وَلَٰكِنَّ الْبِرَّ مَنْ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالْكِتَابِ وَالنَّبِيِّينَ
evidence.translation_en: But righteousness is one who believes in Allah, the Last Day, the angels, the Book, and the prophets.
evidence.why_cited: It defines righteousness by what the heart holds.

sections.heading: The knowledge of Allah
sections.body: The Quran ties purpose to knowing Allah. It is not only worship in action. It is worship in awareness.

evidence.arabic: فَاعْلَمْ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
evidence.translation_en: So know that there is no deity except Allah.
evidence.why_cited: The command is to know, not only to say.

evidence.arabic: اللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ وَمِنَ الْأَرْضِ مِثْلَهُنَّ
evidence.translation_en: It is Allah who has created seven heavens and of the earth, the like of them.
evidence.why_cited: It names creation as a means of knowing.

evidence.arabic: إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَآيَاتٍ لِّأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ
evidence.translation_en: Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the night and the day are signs for those of understanding.
evidence.why_cited: It names the signs for those who reflect.

sections.heading: The end of the path
sections.body: The Quran places the return to Allah as the end of the path. The purpose runs toward that meeting.

evidence.translation_en: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return.
evidence.why_cited: It names the origin and the return.

evidence.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الْإِنسَانُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَاقِيهِ
evidence.translation_en: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with effort and will meet Him.
evidence.why_cited: It names the meeting as certain.

evidence.arabic: فَمَن كَانَ يَرْجُو لِقَاءَ رَبِّهِ فَلْيَعْمَلْ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا
evidence.translation_en: So whoever hopes for the meeting with his Lord, let him do righteous work.
evidence.why_cited: It links hope of the meeting with action.
